players.product: Enhanced geothermal (EGS) 24/7 baseload power from modular GeoBlocks (Cape Station geocluster, Utah) under long-term PPAs with hyperscalers, utilities and industrial buyers, grid-connected and behind-the-meter

quarterly_data.signal: Fervo's 8-K release: the first GeoBlock at Cape Station synchronized to the grid on September 24 and declared commercial operation on September 30, one day before its contractual COD, and is generating revenue under its PPA with 33 MW of net power production, meeting the PPA's expected production threshold. The remaining two Phase I GeoBlocks are expected to reach contractual COD by January 1, 2027; the 400 MW Phase II is under construction for an expected 2028 COD. The first GeoBlock power facility was built and commissioned in 23 months, and Fervo is confident it can reach an 18-month construction timeline for future GeoBlocks.
quarterly_data.figure: first GeoBlock COD September 30, 2026 at 33 MW net; remaining Phase I GeoBlocks by January 1, 2027; Phase II 400 MW in 2028

quarterly_data.signal: CFO David Ulrey (8-K release on first commercial operation): 'With over 1 gigawatt of binding PPAs signed across our portfolio, the COD of this first GeoBlock is the beginning of our build into a durable base of predictable, long-term revenue generation.'
quarterly_data.figure: over 1 gigawatt of binding PPAs signed
